description: Extract contact details from a web page: email addresses (including mailto links and [at]-obfuscated ones), phone numbers (tel links and visible numbers) and postal addresses from structured data. Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: contacts
title: Extract contact details from a web page
